title: anim.ragdoll/1
description: data/anim/ragdoll.json: the active ragdoll (docs/animation/overhaul-plan.md, pose-pipeline.md section 9.8): angular degrees of freedom on springs around the posed target, stepped once per sim tick from the body's own velocity and acceleration. Render only, outside the sim's data hash. Version field: schema. Policy: closed except keys starting with an underscore. Cross-references and orders (dof ids unique; bones exist in profiles.json bone_lag; lo below hi; k_loose not above k_stiff; tuck, brace and tsg inside lo..hi (a warning); a0 at most a_max; the pairs in regimes rise) are checked by tools/lib/xref-fight.js (ragdoll-*).

items.description: One angular degree of freedom on a spring around the posed target. Angles in radians about the bone's local z unless axis is x.

bone.description: A bone in profiles.json bone_lag (checked by tools/lib/xref-fight.js, ragdoll-bone).

bone2.description: A second bone that takes the rest of the angle (with share on the first).

share.description: The share of the angle that goes to bone; the rest goes to bone2.

axis.description: z is the sagittal plane; x is an arm lifting out sideways or a side bend; y is a twist about the bone.

beta.description: The limb's rest direction in the body plane (0 hangs down, 3.14159 points up).

k_stiff.description: The spring (1/s^2) when the pose is in charge.

k_loose.description: The spring (1/s^2) when the body is loose.

tsg.description: The angle an arm or leg opens to at full speed.

tuck.description: The target angle of the tuck.

brace.description: The target angle of the brace.

arch.description: Optional. The angle this degree of freedom takes in an arched fall (the ragdoll variety: docs/animation/ragdoll-slices.md).

lag.description: Optional. Ticks this degree of freedom trails the one before it down the chain.

oop.description: Optional. 1: an out-of-plane degree of freedom (a twist or a side bend). The shapes of ragdoll_motion.json hold numbers for the in-plane ones only (rule ragdoll-motion-dofs).

drive.description: How the body's own motion drives the ragdoll.

v0.description: The velocity (u/s) that counts as one unit of drag.

a0.description: The acceleration (u/s^2) that counts as one unit of inertial whip.

gate.description: Below this drive the pose is in charge.

free_rate.description: How fast the body goes loose (per second).

free.description: How loose the body is in each state.

tuck_spin.description: The spin (rad/s) range, low then high, at which a tuck happens.

brace_time.description: The time (s) range, low then high, a brace takes.

hz.description: How fast the variety wanders, in Hz.

side_dead.description: The dead zone of the side it leans to.

variety.description: Optional. A slow per-body variety so two bodies thrown the same way do not fall the same (ragdoll variety).
